description: This file defines an Express middleware function 'extractOrganization' that extracts an organization identifier from HTTP request headers, query parameters, or request body, and attaches it to the request object for downstream use. It also provides helper functions for filtering and stamping documents with organization info, and includes debug logging.

methods.name: extractOrganization
methods.description: Main middleware function that extracts organization ID from request and attaches helper functions and properties to the request object.
